problems.why: Finding 5 says the big tax figure isn't explained where it appears (the explanation only comes later in the brown box), which is a clear part of the person's complaint that the large income-tax figure doesn't make clear which money it applies to; finding 1 is about the default 5-year setting and finding 7 about the salary threshold, not this.

None of the findings names this problem: finding 1 is about the 5-year default showing tax before the exemption, finding 5 is about where the tax explanation sits on the page, and finding 7 points only to the cause (salary above the ceiling), not to tax still shown after 6 years with no clear statement of which money it applies to.

Finding 7 says the page never explains what a salary above the 15,712 ceiling means for the user, which is a clear part of the person's complaint that a high salary brings an unexplained income-tax charge; findings 1 and 5 are about the default 5-year tax figure, not the high-salary case after 6 years.
